title: universe_symbols row
description: Logical row for table universe_symbols (see shared/databases/migrations/007_momentum.sql). Eligible US common-stock universe per MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §3.1, refreshed weekly by data-universe. Ineligible symbols are retained with is_eligible=false and a populated excluded_reason so exclusions stay auditable. The backfill_* fields are per-symbol checkpoint state for the resumable 3-year bar backfill (§8.1.3), not features.

exchange.description: NASDAQ, NYSE, or NYSE American; OTC excluded in Phase 1

mic.description: Market identifier code from the Finnhub symbol list; the reliable exchange discriminator

type.description: Raw instrument type from the symbol list, retained pre-filter for audit

sector.description: From equity_fundamentals; also the grouping key for §3.12 sector strength

shares_outstanding.description: ABSOLUTE share count. Finnhub serves millions; the writer multiplies by 1e6

market_cap.description: USD ABSOLUTE. Finnhub serves $ millions; the writer multiplies by 1e6

excluded_reason.description: Null iff eligible. e.g. type_not_common_stock, exchange_not_allowed, ticker_suffix_excluded, insufficient_history

backfill_cursor_ts.description: Oldest bar fetched so far; the resume point after a crash
